rationale: UK PM pledges continued Ukraine aid before Zelensky visit — modest reassurance on eastern security; wildfires in France/Spain affect EU neighbors but not Poland directly.

top_events.title: UK PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit

top_events.summary: New UK leader Burnham reaffirms military aid to Ukraine before Zelensky's first visit, reducing uncertainty about Western support on Poland's eastern border.
